item.title: Halide 3.2 Adds Full Aperture Control for iPhone 18 Pro
item.description: Halide 3.2 removes Apple’s four‑stop limit, giving iPhone 18 Pro users unrestricted f‑stop selection, manual ISO, new film sims and a 16:9 mode.
